gui.contracts.title: Contracts & Bounties
gui.contracts.refresh_hint: Refresh contracts and balance. Also lets you retry after a connection failure.
gui.contracts.credit: Awaiting collection: %s. Credit stays saved if it cannot be collected right now.
gui.contracts.item_hint: Use the full identifier, such as minecraft:oak_log. Only materials without additional components can be delivered.
gui.contracts.quantity_hint: Between 1 and 4096 items. Deliver the entire quantity at once.
gui.contracts.reward_coins_hint: Amount in euros with up to two decimal places. Example: 20.50
gui.contracts.reward_emeralds_hint: A whole number of emeralds. Example: 20
gui.contracts.escrow_hint: The reward is reserved when you publish. After delivery, collect your materials from this board.
gui.contracts.error_title: Enter a title between 1 and 64 characters long.
gui.contracts.error_item: The material identifier is invalid or does not exist.
gui.contracts.error_quantity: Quantity must be a whole number between 1 and 4096.
gui.contracts.error_reward: The reward must be positive with no more than two decimal places.
gui.contracts.error_whole_emeralds: The emerald reward must be a positive whole number.
gui.contracts.author: Published by %s
gui.contracts.no_deliveries: You have no materials to collect.
gui.contracts.deliveries_hint: Materials saved for you. Collect as much as fits in your inventory; the rest stays on the board.
gui.contracts.empty: There are no open contracts yet.
gui.contracts.error_reward_limit: The maximum reward per contract is %s.
gui.contracts.no_response: No server response. Refresh or reopen the board before repeating the request.
gui.contracts.completed: Materials delivered. Your reward is ready to collect.
gui.contracts.cancelled: Contract cancelled. Your refund is ready to collect.
gui.contracts.nothing_money: There is no credit to collect, or no room available.
gui.contracts.items_claimed: Materials collected. Anything that did not fit remains stored.
gui.contracts.nothing_items: There are no materials to collect, or no inventory space available.
gui.contracts.currency_changed: The currency has changed. Refresh the board.
gui.contracts.board_range: Move closer to the board to continue.
gui.contracts.profile_required: Create your Chronicles RP character before publishing contracts.
gui.contracts.own_contract: You cannot complete your own contract.
gui.contracts.only_author: Only the author can cancel this contract.
gui.contracts.unavailable: This contract does not exist or is no longer available.
gui.contracts.settled: This contract has already been completed or cancelled. Refresh the board.
gui.contracts.archive_full: The contract archive is full. Contact the server administrator.
gui.contracts.too_many: You already have the maximum number of open contracts.
gui.contracts.insufficient_items: Not enough unmodified items in your main inventory (without a custom name, enchantments or contents).
